_doc: Golden vectors for the accent contrast gate. Generated by an independent Python implementation of the WCAG 2.x formula; read by control-plane/brandtext_golden_test.go AND web/viewer/src/lib/brand_contrast.test.ts so the two implementations cannot drift. Ratios are to 4 decimals (compared within 0.00005). Accent cases carry the exact server refusal text.
